Name: JP's Teleporter Menu Mod - Warp Menu
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u]Teleporter Menu Mod[/u][/color][/size][/i][/b][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]I left my character here, and now he's gone... >:([/i][/b][/size][/color]



[size=4][i][b]This mod adds a simple teleportation menu that you can customize to your liking, allowing you to travel anywhere you want without restrictions. [/b][/i][/size]


[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]How it works:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]On PC, use the [color=#ffff00][b]Left Ctrl + A[/b][/color] shortcut to open the menu (configurable in GMCM)[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/LXHfpZKv/Camarawe.gif[/img]

[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]On Mobile, [b][color=#ffff00]press with three fingers for one second[/color][/b] (the number of fingers and duration can be configured in GMCM) to open the menu. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/sxxhBd2Q/Camarawe1.gif[/img]

[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Create a new Warp using the “Create Warps” button; the coordinates used will be where your character is currently standing. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Edit the names of the Warps by tapping the book icon. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Delete a Warp by tapping the trash can button and confirm your decision. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Add your Warp to your favorites using the star button. Each section will have its own favorites. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Create a new section using the “New Section” button. This adds a sidebar where you can move the warps you want using the magnifying glass button next to each warp. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Tap the hand icon and drag it to reorder the Warps however you like. This also works with the sections. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][i]The data is stored in the Warps folder, in a file named warps.json. You can edit this file manually if you don't want to visit each location you want to teleport to. 
[/i][/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=5][i]This file is unique, so you can share it with your friends so they can have the same settings as you![/i][/size][/color]



[color=#00ff00][size=6][b][i]That's about it, it's pretty basic and there might be a few things that need tweaking. If you have any suggestions or find any bugs, please let me know. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Georgia]

[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
